answer: Mechanism: Topological Path-Persistence Credit (TPPC). Independent observers trace routes from each agent to three disjoint vantage sets (plume, terrace, juniper) over sliding epochs and compute the minimum count of edge-disjoint, latency-stable paths, penalizing shared AS/IX and route-overlap. Routing weight scales with that score; low-score agents are throttled. Sybils need many distinct network locations and sustained non-overlapping traffic, not just cheap identities; VPS/NAT clusters collapse into shared chokepoints.
